outcome.goal: Import the supplied venue list into the bookings table.
outcome.deliverable: A migration script and a count of imported rows.

facts.text: The bookings table has columns venue_id, name and capacity.
Capacity is stored as an integer number of seats.

sources.label: Coordinator note
sources.content:
Rows with capacity 0 are placeholders.
Skip them.

dependencies.text: The database migration tool must be installed before the script runs.
The CSV is the final version; no newer export exists.

criteria.text: The imported row count equals the non-placeholder rows in venues.csv.

requirements.text: Import every row whose capacity is greater than 0.

authorized.text: writing to the bookings table in the development database.

confirm.text: running the migration against the production database.
